Maya (support): Heads up — multiple customers reporting 429s this morning, then a sudden burst of requests that overloaded a couple inference pools. Repro notes below.
Ravi (eng-sre): Can you paste the alerts/log links?
Maya (support): https://monitoring.internal/r/redwood/alerts/3821 — top errors are 429 rate_limited, then around 08:18 a spike in 503/timeouts from overloaded routers. Timeline from support: 08:14 429s start, 08:18 backend timeouts, 08:20 huge request surge.
Jordan (oncall): I see an alert for limiter backfill on pool "dedicated-west-1-g4". Could backfill logic be refilling tokens after temporary outage and allowing a large burst?
Ava (eng-runtime): Dug into limiter logs: the template shows refill_unit=1 but logs indicate refill_interval_ms=1 in the rendered config. Looks like unit mismatch (ms vs s). Snippet: `limiter.refill_unit=1`, rendered as `refill_interval_ms=1`.
Ravi (eng-sre): If refill is treated as ms when expected as s, tokens would be added ~1000x faster — explains the sudden burst. Any recent template changes?
Maya (support): Deploy records show infra-rollout bot applied limiter-template v2.3.7 at 2026-03-17T08:12. @deploy-bot can you confirm the deploy details?
deploy-bot: Deployed infra-rollout/limiter-template v2.3.7 at 2026-03-17T08:12 by infra-automation.
Ben (support): Immediate mitigation options: rollback template, enforce safe caps, or scale pools temporarily. Which is fastest?
Jordan (oncall): I'll push a hotfix to the template to set explicit units and a conservative cap. Applying: set refill_unit=seconds and cap_refill_qps=100. Rolling patch at 08:25 now.
ops-bot: Rollback initiated for infra-rollout/limiter-template -> reverting to v2.3.6.
Ava (eng-runtime): After hotfix & rollback, error rates dropped back to baseline. Queues drained and pools stabilized. Monitors green ~08:33.
Ravi (eng-sre): Preliminary root cause: config pipeline accepted free-form refill_unit and a recent change allowed shorthand that pipeline interpreted as ms. No validation blocked it.
Maya (support): We're drafting a customer note with timeline and mitigation. Need postmortem and concrete action items.
Ben (support): Proposed action items: 1) schema validation for limiter templates (reject ambiguous units), 2) unit tests for template rendering, 3) canary rollout for infra templates, 4) monitor/alert on sudden token refill spikes, 5) runbook for immediate rollback.
Ravi (eng-sre): Owners: schema validation -> Ava, canary rollout -> Jordan, alerting -> Ravi, customer comms -> Maya. ETA 48h for initial fixes.
Maya (support): Thanks all — support will follow up with affected customers and link the postmortem when ready. Closing incident thread, will open formal postmortem doc and link here.
Jordan (oncall): Confirmed fixes deployed and monitoring in place. Leaving follow-up tasks in our tracker. :thumbsup:
Ava (eng-runtime): I also added a quick unit test to fail on ambiguous units and a temporary alert rule for refill_rate > 10x baseline.
Ben (support): Noted; I'll update customers and mark tickets resolved after postmortem.
